probes.text: Missandei asks Grey Worm why some of the Unsullied still pay visits to brothels.
Tyrion, drunk and miserable, is cooped up in a Pentos manse with Varys before they set out east.
Littlefinger leaves young Robin in the keeping of a Vale lord before he and Sansa ride away.

2.title: The House of Black and White

probes.text: Newly arrived in Braavos, Arya makes her way to a building the locals call the House of Black and White.
Littlefinger and Sansa break their journey at a crowded roadside tavern, where other travellers are eating and drinking.
Brienne and Podrick ride off on their own again, keeping their distance behind another party on the road.
Brienne puts Podrick through sword drills, correcting his grip and stance as they travel.

fine_only.text: Arya throws her clothes and belongings into the Braavosi harbour, but slips Needle into a hiding place among rocks.

probes.text: Melisandre comes to Jon at Castle Black and tries to seduce him into riding south with Stannis.
Jaime and Bronn come ashore secretly on the Dornish coast, there to retrieve Myrcella without anyone's knowledge.
Hizdahr zo Loraq presses Daenerys once again to reopen Meereen's fighting pits as an old local tradition.
Tyrion and Jorah sail in a small boat through the drowned ruins of Valyria, a dragon passing overhead.
Brienne and Podrick take a room at an inn within sight of Winterfell and quietly get word inside.
Stannis breaks camp at the Wall, his army marching out with his family and the red priestess in tow.
Jaime and Bronn move quietly through the pools and terraces of the Dornish Water Gardens.
Olenna arrives in King's Landing and sits down with Cersei to talk bluntly about the Tyrell alliance.
Daenerys and her consort walk the empty sands of the great fighting pit, inspecting it ahead of the games.
Disguised as a peddler wheeling a cart of shellfish through Braavos, Arya watches a man who sells insurance to shipowners.
Jon and Tormund stand before a crowd of Wildlings in a bleak seaside settlement, arguing for passage south.
Mace Tyrell has come to Braavos to negotiate with the Iron Bank on the crown's behalf.
Daenerys takes her seat above Daznak's pit as the fighting resumes before a packed crowd.
Stannis dispatches Davos back to Castle Black to request more supplies for the snowbound camp.

fine_only.text: Samwell asks to be sent south to Oldtown to train as a maester, taking Gilly and the baby with him.
fine_only.reason: It reveals a major plot turning point — Sam's departure from Castle Black for Oldtown with Gilly — a development the viewer has not yet seen.
